rom_capacity_density_bits_mm2.note: storage_rom_bits_per_mm2 / cim_cell_area_multiplier. N6 compute-in-ROM array capacity density: a larger cell holds proportionally fewer bits in the same silicon
rom_capacity_density_bits_mm2.source: https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/1989 ; no fabricated leading-node mask-ROM bitcell has been published for this program ; no published mask-ROM macro floorplan at a leading node ; no published compute-in-ROM bitcell at any node

rom_cell_area_multiplier.note: area of a compute-in-ROM cell relative to a storage-only mask-ROM cell. A compute-in-ROM cell carries a pass transistor and the product-line wiring that lets it select one pre-computed partial product, on top of the via programming that stores its bits. Taalas describes one transistor per 4-bit parameter doing both, so the multiplier is small but cannot be 1.0. This is the second most load-bearing assumption in this file after the ROM-to-SRAM cell ratio, and it decides the storage-versus-compute-in-ROM comparison.
rom_cell_area_multiplier.source: no published compute-in-ROM bitcell at any node

rom_full_array_sweep_time_s.note: rom_capacity_density_bytes_mm2 / (rom_read_bandwidth_density * rom_read_efficiency). time to read every stored weight once; independent of model size, batch and expert coverage, so it is a hard per-token ceiling for a ROM design. It is also independent of the CELL, because both densities carry the cell-area multiplier: a compute-in-ROM array and a storage-only array sweep in the same time and differ only in how much they hold
rom_full_array_sweep_time_s.source: https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/1989 ; no fabricated leading-node mask-ROM bitcell has been published for this program ; no published mask-ROM macro floorplan at a leading node ; no published compute-in-ROM bitcell at any node ; https://doi.org/10.1145/3489517.3530576 ; counting convention: one multiply plus one add is two operations ; https://en.wikichip.org/wiki/28_nm_lithography_process ; https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/1989 ; no published compute-in-ROM bitcell at any node ; no fabricated array to measure

rom_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.note: storage_rom_read_bytes_s_per_mm2 / cim_cell_area_multiplier. N6 compute-in-ROM array read-bandwidth density: a larger cell means fewer cells per mm2 and no extra bitlines or sense amps
rom_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.source: https://doi.org/10.1145/3489517.3530576 ; counting convention: one multiply plus one add is two operations ; https://en.wikichip.org/wiki/28_nm_lithography_process ; https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/1989 ; no published compute-in-ROM bitcell at any node

rom_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: Fraction of the ROM array's peak sweep rate sustained in practice. A mask-ROM sweep is the most regular access pattern available -- a compile-time-fixed linear walk of the whole array with no arbitration, no conflicts and no refresh -- so 0.75 is a conservative charge and 0.90-1.00 is arguable. The study reports the underated ceiling alongside it because this derate moves the ROM answer directly.

sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.note: 1e6 um2/mm2 / (bitcell_um2 / array_efficiency). N6 6T high-density SRAM array capacity density in bits/mm2
sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.source: https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/1989 ; no vendor macro floorplan published for the target arrays

sram_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.note: (anchor_sram_read_bytes_s / anchor_die_area_mm2) * (anchor_bitcell_um2 / target_bitcell_um2). N6 SRAM array read-bandwidth density in bytes/s/mm2; the anchor rate is charged against WHOLE-die area and then applied only to array area, which is conservative

sram_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: fraction of the SRAM array's peak read rate sustained by a real gather pattern

designs.sizing_rule: smallest device count within 2% of the best per-user latency at batch 1, bounded at 4x the minimum feasible count. SRAM-KV designs are sized at batch 1 because SRAM is silicon area; HBM-KV designs are provisioned for batch 256 for both KV capacity and enough KV bandwidth to keep KV off the critical path ahead of the ROM sweep, capped by the die-edge beachfront a shipping GPU achieves

area_split_per_device.policy: compute-in-ROM: cells 1.6x a storage-only bit, no MAC array, pre-compute block only, spare silicon to a replicated array copy

rom_cell_area_multiplier.note: area of a compute-in-ROM cell relative to a storage-only mask-ROM cell. rom_cell_area_multiplier.note: area of a compute-in-ROM cell relative to a storage-only mask-ROM cell. A compute-in-ROM cell carries a pass transistor and the product-line wiring that lets it select one pre-computed partial product, on top of the via programming that stores its bits. Taalas describes one transistor per 4-bit parameter doing both, so the multiplier is small but cannot be 1.0. This is the second most load-bearing assumption in this file after the ROM-to-SRAM cell ratio, and it decides the storage-versus-compute-in-ROM comparison.
rom_cell_area_multiplier.source: no published compute-in-ROM bitcell at any node

rom_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: Fraction of the ROM array's peak sweep rate sustained in practice. A mask-ROM sweep is the most regular access pattern available -- a compile-time-fixed linear walk of the whole array with no arbitration, no conflicts and no refresh -- so 0.75 is a conservative charge and 0.90-1.00 is arguable. The study reports the underated ceiling alongside it because this derate moves the ROM answer directly.

Taalas describes one transistor per 4-bit parameter doing both, so the multiplier is small but cannot be 1.0. This is the second most load-bearing assumption in this file after the ROM-to-SRAM cell ratio, and it decides the storage-versus-compute-in-ROM comparison.
rom_cell_area_multiplier.source: no published compute-in-ROM bitcell at any node

rom_full_array_sweep_time_s.note: rom_capacity_density_bytes_mm2 / (rom_read_bandwidth_density * rom_read_efficiency). time to read every stored weight once; independent of model size, batch and expert coverage, so it is a hard per-token ceiling for a ROM design. It is also independent of the CELL, because both densities carry the cell-area multiplier: a compute-in-ROM array and a storage-only array sweep in the same time and differ only in how much they hold

rom_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.note: storage_rom_read_bytes_s_per_mm2 / cim_cell_area_multiplier. N6 compute-in-ROM array read-bandwidth density: a larger cell means fewer cells per mm2 and no extra bitlines or sense amps
rom_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.source: https://doi.org/10.1145/3489517.3530576 ; counting convention: one multiply plus one add is two operations ; https://en.wikichip.org/wiki/28_nm_lithography_process ; https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/1989 ; no published compute-in-ROM bitcell at any node

rom_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: Fraction of the ROM array's peak sweep rate sustained in practice. A mask-ROM sweep is the most regular access pattern available -- a compile-time-fixed linear walk of the whole array with no arbitration, no conflicts and no refresh -- so 0.75 is a conservative charge and 0.90-1.00 is arguable. The study reports the underated ceiling alongside it because this derate moves the ROM answer directly.

sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.note: 1e6 um2/mm2 / (bitcell_um2 / array_efficiency). N6 6T high-density SRAM array capacity density in bits/mm2
sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.source: https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/1989 ; no vendor macro floorplan published for the target arrays

sram_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.note: (anchor_sram_read_bytes_s / anchor_die_area_mm2) * (anchor_bitcell_um2 / target_bitcell_um2). N6 SRAM array read-bandwidth density in bytes/s/mm2; the anchor rate is charged against WHOLE-die area and then applied only to array area, which is conservative

sram_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: fraction of the SRAM array's peak read rate sustained by a real gather pattern

designs.sizing_rule: smallest device count within 2% of the best per-user latency at batch 1, bounded at 4x the minimum feasible count. SRAM-KV designs are sized at batch 1 because SRAM is silicon area; HBM-KV designs are provisioned for batch 256 for both KV capacity and enough KV bandwidth to keep KV off the critical path ahead of the ROM sweep, capped by the die-edge beachfront a shipping GPU achieves

area_split_per_device.policy: balanced: ROM sized to the stored weights, SRAM sized to the resident KV, graded fixed fractions for overhead and interconnect, compute takes the rest

rom_cell_area_multiplier.note: area of a compute-in-ROM cell relative to a storage-only mask-ROM cell. A compute-in-ROM cell carries a pass transistor and the product-line wiring that lets it select one pre-computed partial product, on top of the via programming that stores its bits. Taalas describes one transistor per 4-bit parameter doing both, so the multiplier is small but cannot be 1.0. This is the second most load-bearing assumption in this file after the ROM-to-SRAM cell ratio, and it decides the storage-versus-compute-in-ROM comparison.

rom_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: Fraction of the ROM array's peak sweep rate sustained in practice. rom_cell_area_multiplier.note: area of a compute-in-ROM cell relative to a storage-only mask-ROM cell. A compute-in-ROM cell carries a pass transistor and the product-line wiring that lets it select one pre-computed partial product, on top of the via programming that stores its bits. rom_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: Fraction of the ROM array's peak sweep rate sustained in practice. rom_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: Fraction of the ROM array's peak sweep rate sustained in practice. A mask-ROM sweep is the most regular access pattern available -- a compile-time-fixed linear walk of the whole array with no arbitration, no conflicts and no refresh -- so 0.75 is a conservative charge and 0.90-1.00 is arguable. The study reports the underated ceiling alongside it because this derate moves the ROM answer directly.

Taalas describes one transistor per 4-bit parameter doing both, so the multiplier is small but cannot be 1.0. This is the second most load-bearing assumption in this file after the ROM-to-SRAM cell ratio, and it decides the storage-versus-compute-in-ROM comparison.

rom_cell_area_multiplier.note: area of a compute-in-ROM cell relative to a storage-only mask-ROM cell. A compute-in-ROM cell carries a pass transistor and the product-line wiring that lets it select one pre-computed partial product, on top of the via programming that stores its bits. Taalas describes one transistor per 4-bit parameter doing both, so the multiplier is small but cannot be 1.0. This is the second most load-bearing assumption in this file after the ROM-to-SRAM cell ratio, and it decides the storage-versus-compute-in-ROM comparison.
rom_cell_area_multiplier.source: no published compute-in-ROM bitcell at any node

rom_full_array_sweep_time_s.note: rom_capacity_density_bytes_mm2 / (rom_read_bandwidth_density * rom_read_efficiency). time to read every stored weight once; independent of model size, batch and expert coverage, so it is a hard per-token ceiling for a ROM design. It is also independent of the CELL, because both densities carry the cell-area multiplier: a compute-in-ROM array and a storage-only array sweep in the same time and differ only in how much they hold

rom_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.note: storage_rom_read_bytes_s_per_mm2 / cim_cell_area_multiplier. N6 compute-in-ROM array read-bandwidth density: a larger cell means fewer cells per mm2 and no extra bitlines or sense amps
rom_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.source: https://doi.org/10.1145/3489517.3530576 ; counting convention: one multiply plus one add is two operations ; https://en.wikichip.org/wiki/28_nm_lithography_process ; https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/1989 ; no published compute-in-ROM bitcell at any node

rom_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: Fraction of the ROM array's peak sweep rate sustained in practice. A mask-ROM sweep is the most regular access pattern available -- a compile-time-fixed linear walk of the whole array with no arbitration, no conflicts and no refresh -- so 0.75 is a conservative charge and 0.90-1.00 is arguable. The study reports the underated ceiling alongside it because this derate moves the ROM answer directly.

sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.note: 1e6 um2/mm2 / (bitcell_um2 / array_efficiency). N6 6T high-density SRAM array capacity density in bits/mm2
sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.source: https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/1989 ; no vendor macro floorplan published for the target arrays

sram_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.note: (anchor_sram_read_bytes_s / anchor_die_area_mm2) * (anchor_bitcell_um2 / target_bitcell_um2). N6 SRAM array read-bandwidth density in bytes/s/mm2; the anchor rate is charged against WHOLE-die area and then applied only to array area, which is conservative

sram_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: fraction of the SRAM array's peak read rate sustained by a real gather pattern

designs.sizing_rule: smallest device count within 2% of the best per-user latency at batch 1, bounded at 4x the minimum feasible count. SRAM-KV designs are sized at batch 1 because SRAM is silicon area; HBM-KV designs are provisioned for batch 256 for both KV capacity and enough KV bandwidth to keep KV off the critical path ahead of the ROM sweep, capped by the die-edge beachfront a shipping GPU achieves

area_split_per_device.policy: compute-in-ROM: cells 1.6x a storage-only bit, no MAC array, pre-compute block only, spare silicon to a replicated array copy

rom_cell_area_multiplier.note: area of a compute-in-ROM cell relative to a storage-only mask-ROM cell. A compute-in-ROM cell carries a pass transistor and the product-line wiring that lets it select one pre-computed partial product, on top of the via programming that stores its bits. Taalas describes one transistor per 4-bit parameter doing both, so the multiplier is small but cannot be 1.0. This is the second most load-bearing assumption in this file after the ROM-to-SRAM cell ratio, and it decides the storage-versus-compute-in-ROM comparison.
rom_cell_area_multiplier.source: no published compute-in-ROM bitcell at any node

rom_full_array_sweep_time_s.note: rom_capacity_density_bytes_mm2 / (rom_read_bandwidth_density * rom_read_efficiency). time to read every stored weight once; independent of model size, batch and expert coverage, so it is a hard per-token ceiling for a ROM design. It is also independent of the CELL, because both densities carry the cell-area multiplier: a compute-in-ROM array and a storage-only array sweep in the same time and differ only in how much they hold

rom_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: Fraction of the ROM array's peak sweep rate sustained in practice. rom_full_array_sweep_time_s.note: rom_capacity_density_bytes_mm2 / (rom_read_bandwidth_density * rom_read_efficiency). time to read every stored weight once; independent of model size, batch and expert coverage, so it is a hard per-token ceiling for a ROM design. It is also independent of the CELL, because both densities carry the cell-area multiplier: a compute-in-ROM array and a storage-only array sweep in the same time and differ only in how much they hold
rom_full_array_sweep_time_s.source: https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/1989 ; no fabricated leading-node mask-ROM bitcell has been published for this program ; no published mask-ROM macro floorplan at a leading node ; no published compute-in-ROM bitcell at any node ; https://doi.org/10.1145/3489517.3530576 ; counting convention: one multiply plus one add is two operations ; https://en.wikichip.org/wiki/28_nm_lithography_process ; https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/1989 ; no published compute-in-ROM bitcell at any node ; no fabricated array to measure

rom_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.note: storage_rom_read_bytes_s_per_mm2 / cim_cell_area_multiplier. N6 compute-in-ROM array read-bandwidth density: a larger cell means fewer cells per mm2 and no extra bitlines or sense amps
rom_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.source: https://doi.org/10.1145/3489517.3530576 ; counting convention: one multiply plus one add is two operations ; https://en.wikichip.org/wiki/28_nm_lithography_process ; https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/1989 ; no published compute-in-ROM bitcell at any node

rom_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: Fraction of the ROM array's peak sweep rate sustained in practice. A mask-ROM sweep is the most regular access pattern available -- a compile-time-fixed linear walk of the whole array with no arbitration, no conflicts and no refresh -- so 0.75 is a conservative charge and 0.90-1.00 is arguable. The study reports the underated ceiling alongside it because this derate moves the ROM answer directly.

sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.note: 1e6 um2/mm2 / (bitcell_um2 / array_efficiency). N6 6T high-density SRAM array capacity density in bits/mm2
sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.source: https://pr.tsmc.com/english/news/1989 ; no vendor macro floorplan published for the target arrays

sram_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.note: (anchor_sram_read_bytes_s / anchor_die_area_mm2) * (anchor_bitcell_um2 / target_bitcell_um2). N6 SRAM array read-bandwidth density in bytes/s/mm2; the anchor rate is charged against WHOLE-die area and then applied only to array area, which is conservative

sram_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: fraction of the SRAM array's peak read rate sustained by a real gather pattern

designs.sizing_rule: smallest device count within 2% of the best per-user latency at batch 1, bounded at 4x the minimum feasible count. SRAM-KV designs are sized at batch 1 because SRAM is silicon area; HBM-KV designs are provisioned for batch 256 for both KV capacity and enough KV bandwidth to keep KV off the critical path ahead of the ROM sweep, capped by the die-edge beachfront a shipping GPU achieves

area_split_per_device.policy: published part: die area is stated for the iso-area comparison, not allocated by this model; capacity, bandwidth and roofs are published

rom_read_bandwidth.note: Fraction of the ROM array's peak sweep rate sustained in practice. A mask-ROM sweep is the most regular access pattern available -- a compile-time-fixed linear walk of the whole array with no arbitration, no conflicts and no refresh -- so 0.75 is a conservative charge and 0.90-1.00 is arguable. The study reports the underated ceiling alongside it because this derate moves the ROM answer directly.

sram_read_bandwidth.note: fraction of the SRAM array's peak read rate sustained by a real gather pattern

stage_balance.note: penalty applied to a multi-device pipeline for imperfect layer balance across devices

phy_area_mm2_per_stack.note: A 1024-bit HBM PHY plus controller is commonly quoted between 8 and 15 mm2 at 7 nm class. Sweep that range.

hop_latency_s.note: NVLink point-to-point sits around 1 us for small messages. A real all-reduce is two phases through a switch plus launch and synchronisation overhead, so 1.5 us is optimistic; 3-10 us is common in practice. Sweep upward, never downward.
300 ns per organic/silicon-interposer chiplet hop. Not measured.

hop_latency_s.note: 100 ns per on-wafer reticle-to-reticle hop; a stitched on-wafer link has no SerDes, no packet framing and no switch, so it is well under a package hop. Not measured.

technology_derivations.rom_sweep_note: The ROM full-array sweep time is rom_capacity_density divided by rom_read_bandwidth_density. Both scale with the same published bitcell-area ratio under this derivation, so the sweep time -- and hence the ROM path's hard per-token ceiling -- is the SAME at every node. Process scaling buys a ROM design capacity, not per-token speed. No clock-frequency bonus is credited, which makes this the conservative reading.

sram_capacity_bits_per_mm2.note: 1e6 um2/mm2 / (bitcell_um2 / array_efficiency). N6 6T high-density SRAM array capacity density in bits/mm2

sram_read_bytes_s_per_mm2.note: (anchor_sram_read_bytes_s / anchor_die_area_mm2) * (anchor_bitcell_um2 / target_bitcell_um2). N6 SRAM array read-bandwidth density in bytes/s/mm2; the anchor rate is charged against WHOLE-die area and then applied only to array area, which is conservative

kv_access_granularity_bytes.note: An HBM3 channel is split into two 32-bit pseudo-channels and the minimum burst is 8, so the smallest read that reaches the die is 32 bytes. A 68-byte index entry therefore costs 96 bytes. Graded assumed rather than published because the number is reconstructed from the interface geometry rather than read off a datasheet line.
kv_access_granularity_bytes.source: HBM3/3E pseudo-channel width times burst length; no vendor erratum consulted for this program

rom_cell_area_multiplier.note: area of a compute-in-ROM cell relative to a storage-only mask-ROM cell. A compute-in-ROM cell carries a pass transistor and the product-line wiring that lets it select one pre-computed partial product, on top of the via programming that stores its bits. Taalas describes one transistor per 4-bit parameter doing both, so the multiplier is small but cannot be 1.0. This is the second most load-bearing assumption in this file after the ROM-to-SRAM cell ratio, and it decides the storage-versus-compute-in-ROM comparison.
rom_cell_area_multiplier.source: no published compute-in-ROM bitcell at any node

rom_full_array_sweep_time_s.note: rom_capacity_density_bytes_mm2 / (rom_read_bandwidth_density * rom_read_efficiency). time to read every stored weight once; independent of model size, batch and expert coverage, so it is a hard per-token ceiling for a ROM design. It is also independent of the CELL, because both densities carry the cell-area multiplier: a compute-in-ROM array and a storage-only array sweep in the same time and differ only in how much they hold

layer_fixed_latency_band.note: The per-layer latency terms are derived from primitives independent of this anchor -- SRAM access time, sequencer issue and decode, pipeline fill and drain across a dependent array-pass boundary, the layer barrier, and a floorplan-derived on-die wire delay -- and are reported at both ends of their stated range. A negative 'per_layer_cost_that_would_close_the_gap_s' means the model is already slower than the shipping part before any fixed cost is charged, so no value of this term could have closed the gap and the residual lies elsewhere.
